name: WorkflowROI
subtitle: Automation Economics & Decision Simulator
headline: Automation should earn
description: Compare manual, partial and AI-assisted operating models. Explore review workload, error losses, adoption and payback before committing to an expensive system.
boundary: Forecasts under explicit user assumptions; no savings or error probabilities were measured. Confidence labels are not calibrated probabilities.
method: Set task volume, manual time, labor rates, implementation, maintenance and model/tool costs.
Model residual manual work, human review and unresolved errors in three operating modes.
Compute weekly risk-adjusted costs, positive-savings payback and first-year net value.
Vary adoption and error loss independently to find where the decision changes.
Recommend a measured pilot or do not automate when the economics fail the one-year horizon.
footer: Forecasts, not outcomes · assumptions beside every result
article: When the right automation recommendation is “do not automate”
summary: A decision simulator for manual, partially automated and AI-assisted workflows, with review/error economics, adoption, maintenance, risk-adjusted savings, break-even, sensitivity analysis and explicit do-not-automate recommendations.
